author: Hastings, Max
title: Retribution: The Battle for Japan, 1944–45
edition: Published in Britain in 2007 by HarperPress as Nemesis: The Battle for Japan, 1944–45; the two are the same book under different titles and their pagination is not interchangeable
notes: The last year at human scale — the Philippines, the submarine campaign, the firebombing, Okinawa, the atomic bombs and the Soviet entry — told through participants on both sides, in the manner of source:hastings-2013 for 1914. Rule 9 of docs/sources.md applies exactly as it does there: take narrative colour and well-known episodes from it, and take numbers and positions from Morison, the Green Books or the Marine histories. Hastings also passes judgement freely, on Japanese conduct and on Allied commanders alike, and those judgements are cited as his. Verified against the Internet Archive's cataloguing of the physical book (New York, Alfred A. Knopf, 2008), whose record carries the British title as a variant; no ISBN is recorded.
